name: Emilio Herrera Lozano
tagline: Herrera means blacksmith in Spanish. I took it literally.
bio: Herrera means blacksmith in Spanish — and I took it literally. I'm a Product Engineer forging full-scale software end-to-end: interfaces, serverless backends, and AI features built on LLM workflows and agentic systems.

By day I'm a Software Engineer at Finsphera, designing and shipping end-to-end product features. By night I run Blacksmith Softworks, my studio for web apps, tools, and videogames. Rooted in Game & Interactive Media Design, I sweat the details people feel but don't see.

points: Designed and built end-to-end product features, spanning UI/UX design, serverless backend architecture, and infrastructure.
Developed AI-driven features using LLM workflows and agentic systems to automate complex application tasks.
Built responsive, high-performance web interfaces using Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.
A software development company focused on making useful and fun experiences, from web apps to videogames.
Developed the community website (Wix + design in Figma).
Designed social media posts to drive brand awareness and growth.

education.degree: Bachelor's, Game and Interactive Media Design
